decision: Experiment with CommitText while the existing active composition is still visible; retire its presentation afterwards on the same output contract. Never retry or synthesize a cursor or retain an invalid pair continuation.

consequence_analysis.authority: Existing UserInput or AuthorizedEdit still gates CommitText. DecisionCore, owner/epoch, pair exactness, selection/caret revocation and verifier remain unchanged.
consequence_analysis.failure: Commit failure preserves the typed buffer and visible composition. Once CommitText succeeds, later presentation-clear failure must retire the committed buffer and preserve only existing clear-retry bookkeeping, preventing duplicate insertion.
consequence_analysis.atomic: AtomicEffectBuilder already serializes commit before hide. Preserve its effect payloads and speculative-transaction rejection on error; no new atomic operation.
consequence_analysis.race_and_lifetime: No new owner, generation, cache, queue, timer, request, deadline or retry. Existing GTK/Qt clients may respond differently to signal ordering; original native scope required.
consequence_analysis.ranking_learning_privacy: No candidate, dictionary, ranking or learning changes; metadata diagnostics only.
consequence_analysis.performance_package: Same number of output effects, no extra RPC; measure successful latency separately from failed cases. No dependency, package or reload change.
consequence_analysis.consumers: Generic active-composition commit only; committed-tail replacement, terminal transport and physical Double Shift detector/routes unchanged. GTK, Qt, Firefox, Chrome, KWrite and Konsole remain in acceptance scope. GNOME requires separate evidence.
consequence_analysis.rollback: If fixed identities or affected scope regress, reject this ordering experiment and record the reason. Preserve earlier pair-source carry and all failed native evidence. No installation or promotion from focused tests.

proof: Five exact semantic regressions through the production active-composition entrypoint: output order, commit failure, preedit-clear failure, auxiliary-clear failure and atomic payload. Source red/green plus full affected IME tests, architecture/format gates and original native matrices required.
